description: Monroe, GA — Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 46, Marc McMain, today announced the endorsement of three leading law enforcement officials from across the district: Sheriff Jud Smith of Barrow County, Sheriff Keith Brooks of Walton County, and Sheriff James Hale of Oconee County."Supporting local law enforcement is one of my top priorities, which is why I’m truly honored to have the endorsement of all three Republican Sheriffs from our community," said McMain.
